name: keynest
description: Keynest monorepo — Vercel should use Root Directory apps/manager-web (Angular)

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix apps/manager-web && npm run build --prefix apps/manager-web
scripts.start:prod: docker compose -p keynest-local -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f compose.preview.yml up -d --no-deps manager-api && npm run start-api
